name: Gconnect Logitech and Supply Chain Ltd

facts.business: Gconnect Logitech and Supply Chain Limited operates in the logistics industry providing B2B logistics services including transportation, warehousing, and value-added services such as packaging, labelling, and reverse logistics.
key_risks: Increasing Competition from new-age technology logistics startups
Technology Adoption requirements including GPS/GIS tracking
Need for Value-Added Services like packaging, labelling and reverse logistics
Changing Customer Requirements for outsourced logistics
Economic and Industry Conditions affecting demand and supply
Dependence on Government Initiatives and Infrastructure development
